routes.title: How we grew a founder's LinkedIn from 19,000 to 33,544 followers | Revenue Media Lab
headings: How we grew a founder's LinkedIn from 19,000 to 33,544 followers in about 2 months
Before us, his best posts came from big life moments years apart
The system: 6 steps, from research to the week after a hit
1. The Founder Cheatsheet: one questionnaire instead of weekly interviews
2. The Remix Rule: turn old posts into new ones
3. The 3-Rank Idea Bank: know what to write next and how to write it
4. Lesson, Story, Number: give each one-liner proof only the founder has
5. Write 15, Post 10: cut the points anyone else could have written
6. Use the Accordion Method: reach new people with a hit, then keep them with the founder's story

routes.title: How we got a busy founder 3x more posts over 100K impressions | Revenue Media Lab
headings: How we got a busy founder 3x more posts over 100K impressions without any interviews
The founder had 138K followers on X and no time for interviews
We built the system around the founder's own rule, "test, then invest"
1. We spent 50 hours researching the founder before we started
2. Our Hall of Fame turned a 2019 post into 11.1M impressions
3. We wrote down the founder's core ideas, and one thread that used 4 of them did 1M impressions
4. We created hook templates from posts that were already winning
5. One credibility line helped take a career post from 43,908 to 1.6M impressions
6. We battle-tested 3 hooks for every post after one thread flopped
7. New hooks turned a 10,086-impression post into 225,228
